This notice does NOT constitute a request for proposals, request for quote, or invitation for bid. No formal solicitation document exists at this time. The Government will not pay for any information solicited.Â 
The Department of Veterans Affairs Medical Center, Network Contracting Office (NCO) 6, on behalf of the Veterans Integrated Service Network (VISN) 6 Office, is conducting market research to determine whether to set-aside an acquisition for Ophthalmology Supplies for the following sites located at Durham VA Heal Care Center, Fayetteville VA Heal Care Center, Hampton VA Medical Center, Salem VA Medical Center, Salisbury VA Health Care Center and Richmond VA Medical Center. 
The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code for this acquisition is 339113-Surgical Appliance and Supplies Manufacturing, Size Standard 800 Employees, and the Product Service Code (PSC) Classification is 6515- Medical and Surgical Instruments, Equipment and Supplies.
The Department of Veteran Affairs, Veterans Integrated Service Network (VISN) 6 is seeking a vendor who can provide a Base plus 4 option year contract for the following Ophthalmology Supplies:
